_comment: Was a SET_FLAG that nothing reads, so the card did nothing at all. 'Prevent the next N damage' is a one-shot replacement (CR 6.4). Arcane-specific. The second cost destroyed a permanent filtered by HAS_KEYWORD 'Runechant' — a Runechant is a token SLUG, not a keyword, so that filter matched nothing and the cost could never be paid. Arcane Barrier 1 is a printed keyword, read from card data.
